'''Eric Wetterlind''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Mirkwood Team Tournament]] on 23 June 2001 with Rontos and Racing, according to Seth Van Winkle's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2540">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-28-seth-goes-to-mirkwood-6-23-01d2540/ seth-goes-to-mirkwood-6-23-01], DeckTech (Seth "Ooryl" Van Winkle, 28 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-28-seth-goes-to-mirkwood-6-23-01d2540/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
